title: Prospective Evaluation of Computerized Physician Order Entry in the Emergency Department
brief_summary: This study will evaluate various performance metrics of emergency department operations after the implementation of computerized physician order entry in an academic emergency department.
raw_criteria:
Inclusion Criteria:

* All consecutive adult patients (Age \>=18) presenting to the Emergency Department during the study period will be included in the study.

Exclusion Criteria:

* Patients who eloped, left without being seen, or signed out against medical advice will be excluded.
study_population: All patients who are registered in the emergency department \> 18 years of age who do not elope, left without being seen, or leave AMA.
condition: Operational Metrics of the Emergency Department
